Hibiscus Film uses FotufilmCore, FotufilmMetal and the Apple Halide AOT host from [upstream revision d534fc99](https://github.com/DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine/tree/d534fc99c7eee10a839d3bc4ae26501c286b32a0). This is the engine revision for the twenty source profiles in Matrix’s adaptation manifest. The local package selects those library products and supplies a compiled device and Apple Silicon simulator backend. The Swift engine sources and photographic model are upstream code.

The native libraries were generated using upstream’s `tools/generate-halide-aot.sh` with the Halide 22.1.0 Apple Silicon compiler. To rebuild, check out the revision above, set `HALIDE_ROOT` to the compiler installation and run the generator once for `device` and once for `simulator`. Give those two output directories, the engine checkout and a fresh output path to `Tools/package-kernels.sh`. Replace the package's `FotufilmHalide.xcframework` with the result.

The app bundle carries the original stock JSON for rendering, HSpec binaries for exchange, and the attribution, licenses and modification records for those resources. The project keeps the readable HSpec adaptations, conversion inputs and source provenance under `ProfileSources/`. The upstream engine asset inventory is in `Vendor/Fotufilm/SOURCE_ASSETS.json`. User imports live in Application Support. The engine’s working reflectance prior is a separate SwiftPM bundle resource. The profile data, engine and third-party data retain their respective licenses.

Film reads Matrix's HSpec v2 envelope, production type 1, legacy type 2 and legacy illustrative JSON. Import stores the validated original bytes for exchange. Only an exact match of the supported spectral rendering parameters enables a bundled native negative. Matrix editor defaults and unknown optional chunks are retained. Film's local pad coordinates and adjustment strengths are stored per stock and excluded from HSpec export.

The camera catalog contains 30 Fotufilm stocks. Twenty use Matrix’s published HSpec adaptations. The ten native additions and their source hashes are listed in `FilmProfiles.bundle/Fotufilm/native-additions.json` and use their original CC BY-SA 4.0 JSON. Their categories and icon colors are Film library metadata. HSpec export is available for entries with a Matrix-compatible archive.
